title: Crispy Syrian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Syrian dish made with tender lamb, crispy onions, and a blend of aromatic spices. It's a hearty and flavorful meal perfect for a cold night.
instructions: Cut the lamb into 1-inch pieces and season with salt, black pepper, allspice, cumin, and coriander.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add the lemon juice to the pot and stir to combine.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the crispy flatbread.
Return the pot to the oven and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the lamb and onion mixture hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Traditionally, the tagine is served with a side of fluffy rice or crusty bread.
To make the crispy flatbread, slice a pita bread into thin strips and fry in hot oil until crispy.
